name: ai-games
description: Code-generated browser game assets. Workspace layout: packages/schema (pure contracts + PRNG), packages/core (tiny raw-WebGPU runtime), packages/gen (procedural generator library), capsules/ (style capsules: manifest + validate()), assets/ (asset = gen.ts program + asset.json params), apps/playground (Vite live-preview + Tweakpane param editor + finalize lockfile). Root devDeps on workspace packages + zod exist so top-level assets/ and capsules/ (which are not packages) can resolve those imports for both tsc and Vite.
